text: As the City of Toronto’s real estate agency, CreateTO applies a strategic city-wide lens to Toronto’s real estate holdings, develops City buildings and lands for municipal purposes and delivers real estate solutions to advance City Council’s key public policy goals and meet the program needs of City Divisions, Agencies and Corporations (DACs). CreateTO is a self-sustaining agency and submits a net zero budget to the City of Toronto. Through its managed companies Build Toronto and Toronto Port Lands Company, sufficient revenue is generated to fulfil the operating requirements of CreateTO.
